author: rally
body: On the Author's explicit instruction, I checked Rally mail first (none pending) and am sending the next-step request through the established mailbox rather than asking the Author to relay it. Please write the concrete capacity-investigation plan and qualification sequence under existing GOLEM-002 CAP-001–009 / GOLEM-002/capacity/, then return it for Author review before execution. The increase of both text and stack allowances is settled; do not reopen increase-versus-helper-reduction approval. The plan should determine justified runtime ceilings, module declarations and recommended budgets for text/data/image/stack, including service/firmware stack reserve, executable/contiguous/fragmented/peak-load constraints, coherent builder/admission/runtime changes and precise implementation/artifact ownership. Specify graduated independent/mixed-pressure cases, accepted/rejected repeated lifecycle behavior, realistic Rally workloads and generic service pressure, stop/failure criteria, reproducible receipts and the sequence for actual combined-source/glue measurement, Xtensa default/relocated JIT/interpreter, stopped human review and separately authorized physical evidence. Preserve historical receipts and distinguish proposed numbers from implemented/qualified limits. No new stress runs/builds/runtime edits, hardware capacity probes, helper rewrites, Wolf port or upstream adoption are requested by this planning instruction. If a concrete plan already exists, provide its exact path/current status and reconcile any missing points rather than duplicating it. Rally-owned helper and game sources remain with Rally. The Author will ask you to read this mail.
